title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a failed-payment path to the Session 1 sequence diagram
body:
## Problem
The sequence diagram only shows a successful payment.

## Context
Session 1 mentions that a payment above the balance is declined but never draws it.

## Expected outcome
A second picture in which the payer bank answers 'declined' at step 3 and the later steps are replaced by a failure message to the apps.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A new PNG saved in `out/`
- [ ] Ledger numbers beside every arrow
- [ ] Checkpoint still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: reconcile three ledgers
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. The toy switch has one ledger; real systems compare separate ledgers at the end of the day.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a daily limit to the toy switch (the mini-project)
body:
## Problem
The shipped `Switch` has no daily limit, so `rapid_fire_test` drains Rs 36000 in 40 payments.

## Context
See the mini-project text in PROJECT.md. A daily limit caps the damage when fraud rules miss.

## Expected outcome
A `daily_limit` option that refuses a payment taking the day's total above the limit, with the reason `daily limit` in the log.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `PROJECT.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] With a limit of 5000, at most 5 of the 40 payments succeed and at most Rs 4500 leaves the account
- [ ] Ordinary payments on another day still pass
- [ ] All four invariants hold

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: slow-attack detection with few false alarms
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a switch that holds suspicious payments, and the shipped rules miss 19 of 20 slow attacks. There is no public implementation of a better detector.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path; use only the synthetic data from Session 3.

## Expected outcome
Your own scoring function and a write-up of how it works.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least 16 of 20 slow attacks flagged
- [ ] False positive rate at most 5 percent on the seeded data
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
